diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime reported that the Islamic Republic has increasingly relied on the illegal economy to counter US sanctions. The report mentions the expansion of poppy cultivation in Sistan and Baluchestan and the possible production of Captagon. It also highlights the IRGC's revenue from drug trafficking.

Houshang Hasan-Yari stated that the number of missiles launched by the Islamic Republic has decreased. He emphasized that US and Israeli attacks have weakened the missile and drone capabilities of the Islamic Republic. There is also a possibility of resumption of military conflict among these parties.

The 78th Frankfurt International Book Fair is being held with the participation of thousands of publishers, authors, and cultural activists. This year, the absence of the Islamic Republic and the unveiling of a book about the justice-seeking of Ukrainian flight victims are notable topics. The report is by Mehdi Tehrani for Iran International.

Bloomberg reported, citing a Western official, that Russia is supplying missiles to Iran. The Islamic Republic has maintained its missile and drone production facilities and has significant ballistic missile stockpiles. It is also reported that Iran has added newly made Russian weapons to its arsenal.
A citizen criticized the price increase of the Rectol ointment in a video sent to Iran International. He asked what is happening to the people. The video reflects concerns about rising drug prices.

The situation in Karaj and Tehran has become highly secure, with law enforcement controlling young people. In Tehran's District 18, military forces have occupied part of a schoolyard. Additionally, armed police officers visited a school in Semnan and behaved threateningly.

Mahmoud Beheshti Langroudi, a teachers' union activist, was summoned to the third investigative branch of the public and revolutionary prosecutor's office in Langroud. The summons was issued through an official notification.

Shahram Khaledi said Donald Trump is seeking an opportunity to force the Islamic Republic to accept his demands. He also stated that Russia is moving in a path detrimental to the Islamic Republic. These remarks concern international relations and regional policies.

Mahshad Keshani, a political prisoner and wife of Alireza Sepahi, is under intense interrogation in Dolatabad prison in Isfahan, and her contact with the outside has been cut off. The families of Keshani and Sepahi are also under pressure to deny their marriage. The head of the women's section of Dolatabad prison has been accused of putting pressure on Keshani.

The fourth part of the documentary series 'Commanders of the Massacre' titled 'Families Under the Boot of Suppression' will be aired on Saturday at 17:45 and 21:45 Tehran time. This documentary will be broadcast on Iran International.

Ruhollah Rahimpour stated that if the resistances of the US and the Islamic Republic continue, the likelihood of a large-scale war resuming is higher. He pointed to the diplomatic deadlock between the two countries. Even if negotiations resume, the chance of reaching an agreement is close to zero.

The Turkish government condemned the Houthi attacks on two international airports in Saudi Arabia. Ankara emphasized its support for Riyadh. This stance coincides with the expansion of defense cooperation between the two countries under the Mecca Agreement.

A video circulated on social media shows a couple supporting the government organizing a car convoy for their wedding in Tehran. The convoy includes armored vehicles carrying a mounted artillery gun on the street. This event has attracted public attention.

Abdollah Amini and Rahim Haqparast, citizens from Saqez, were released on bail. They had previously been detained along with five other citizens by security forces in Saqez. The other detainees are Seyed Mohammadsaleh Hosseini, Mohammad Hakimpoor, Mostafa Ghaderi, Khaled Rahimi, and Hossein Abdollahi.

The French government announced that more than three thousand substitute teachers will be sent to high schools by next Tuesday. This measure is in response to student protests and teacher shortages. However, protest groups have stated that the demonstrations will continue.

The head of the Crisis Management Organization announced full preparedness to deal with the potential impacts of El Niño in Iran. People have been urged to pay attention to warnings to reduce damages. Multiple rainfall systems are expected to affect northern, western regions and the Zagros mountains.

Tractor football team traveled to Oman for the Asian Elite League. Alireza Beiranvand was expelled from the team due to an interview against club managers and was not allowed to travel. He is also banned from leaving the country due to his military service status.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, stated that Washington intends to identify and seize one billion dollars of cryptocurrency linked to the Islamic Republic by the end of the week. He also announced the expansion of financial and transportation restrictions against Iran. This news was reported by Ahmad Samadi, a journalist from Iran International.

Lida Aleksani, a Christian citizen residing in Tehran, was summoned on Thursday, 16 Mehr, to serve an eight-year prison sentence. She was called to the enforcement branch of the General and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office of Tehran. The summons was issued through an official notification.

A citizen in a video sent to Iran International stated that the average price increase of ready-made soup over two years has been more than 400 percent. He also mentioned that the cost of making homemade soup has become expensive.

Hossein Aghaei said the Moscow-Washington agreement indicates that Russia and the US are seeking to restore their relations. Russia may reduce its intelligence and satellite support for the Islamic Republic in exchange for concessions from the US. Aghaei added that Putin is not trying to save the Islamic Republic and acts based on his own interests.

Abulfazl Khezrian, a member of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, suggested that Trump might take new military action against Iran to prevent the consequences of a possible Republican defeat in the midterm elections. He said this action could occur between mid-November and mid-January. This period is before the new US Congress convenes.

Mehdi Taj announced negotiations with Yahya Golmohammadi for the head coach position of Iran's under-23 team, stating the agreement is close. He said the new coach will be announced soon to start preparing the team for the Los Angeles Olympics. Taj also mentioned he did not have direct negotiations with Afshin Ghotbi.

Mahmoud Amiri-Moghaddam, director of the Iran Human Rights organization, reported an increase in executions in Iran on the International Day Against the Death Penalty. He stated that the Islamic Republic uses executions to create fear and maintain power. He also noted that raising the political cost of executions could slow down the execution process.

The president of Isfahan University of Technology announced that preliminary disciplinary rulings have been issued for about 30 students due to the winter 1404 protests. These rulings include temporary suspension from studies, and no student has been expelled.
A shooting in a commercial unit on Saadi Street in Tehran resulted in the death of a woman. The shooter then shot himself and died. The motive for the incident has not been disclosed.

A group of Iranians residing in San Jose, California, held a silent march on Friday, October 9, coinciding with the Mehregan festival. They protested against the Islamic Republic and supported the national revolution. They also commemorated the martyrs and those executed.

Dmitry Peskov stated that Vladimir Putin, after two meetings with Masoud Pezeshkian, conveyed Tehran's view on a possible solution to end the war to Donald Trump. These meetings took place on the sidelines of a summit in Turkmenistan. No further details were provided about Iran's position or Trump's reaction.

Messages sent to Iran International indicate an increased presence of government forces and the establishment of checkpoints in public places. Videos have been released showing street military training for government supporters and a parade of the so-called 'Jan-Fada' forces. These details were provided by Mohsen Mahimini, a member of Iran International's editorial team.

Fazlollah Ranjbar, the representative of Kermanshah, stated that if the US attacks again, the Islamic Republic will leave its defensive stance. He emphasized that US interests worldwide must be targeted and no concessions should be made. These remarks were made in an interview with Mellat News Agency.

Mohammad Javad Zarif stated that part of the Islamic Republic's foreign policy is threat-based and ambassadors in Syria, Iraq, and Afghanistan mainly represent security institutions. Mohammad Javad Akbarin reacted to these remarks, calling them contradictory. This issue was raised in a video released on social media.

Hossein Farahi was killed on January 8, 2026, in Piroozi Street, Tehran. His mother was seen crying beside his photo in a video shared on social media, saying she will wait for him forever. Hossein Farahi was 32 years old.

The Wall Street Journal reported on the activity of 21 accounts linked to Babak Zanjani's network based on a document from Binance. The US Treasury Secretary stated that Washington plans to identify and seize one billion dollars worth of cryptocurrency linked to Tehran by the end of the week. This move aims to cut off the Islamic Republic's financial access.

Donald Trump called the Nobel Peace Prize decision unfair. He said the prize should have been given to him as the representative of the American people. These remarks were made in an interview with an Iran International reporter.

A group of victims of the Housing Cooperative Company of Municipality Employees in District One of Islamshahr gathered on Saturday in front of the judiciary and prosecutor's office of Islamshahr. They demanded the delivery of lands for which they had made payments since the late 2010s but have not yet received. The protest was held due to the non-delivery of these lands.

Mehdi Taj stated that the facilities of Azadi Stadium have been completely rebuilt and this was not a repair job. He hopes the stadium will be ready for competitions in months 11 or 12. Taj is pessimistic about the timeline announced by the Ministry of Sports but remains hopeful it will be met.
Siamak Mirzaei, a Turkic activist, was released from Ardabil prison after posting a 10 billion toman bail. This occurred on Saturday, 18 Mehr. The news was reported by Harana News Agency.

Ezzatollah Zarghami, former head of IRIB, said that today both extremists and moderates agree that the morality police patrol was a mistake. He also stated that you cannot clean glass with a dirty cloth.

Mohammad Moheydi Azad, the Attorney General of the Islamic Republic, stated that mandatory hijab is among the necessities of religion and official laws of the country. He described enemy infiltration in the field of chastity and hijab as the enemy's first action. He also emphasized the necessity of obeying the law and strengthening the cultural atmosphere of society.

The Yemeni government has requested the UN and Security Council to fully enforce the arms embargo against the Houthis. This request is due to the Houthis' use of Iranian-made weapons and a missile attack on Aden airport. The Yemeni government had previously warned about the threat posed by these weapons.

Donald Trump stated that despite preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons and returning Israeli hostages, neither he nor the US received the Nobel Peace Prize. He also mentioned victory in the Venezuela conflict and the arrest of its dictator. Trump expressed surprise at not receiving the Nobel Peace Prize.

Nosrat Eftekhari, the social and cultural deputy commander of police in Sistan and Baluchestan, was killed in a roadside bomb explosion on the Cheshmeh Ziarat road in Zahedan. This incident occurred amid ongoing armed clashes in the province. An interview was conducted with Mehdi Nakhl Ahmadi regarding the matter.

A group of Iranians residing in Wellington protested in front of the Russian embassy. They objected to a secret deal with the Islamic Republic regarding the Caspian Sea. The protest took place in the capital of New Zealand.

Pressure on Gianni Infantino, FIFA president, to reform football management has increased. Alexander Ceferin's decision to run again in UEFA elections has removed one of Infantino's serious potential rivals in the FIFA elections. This development affects the FIFA election competition.

Sohrab Bakhtiarizadeh said Yaser Asani is an important player but the team performs well without him. He added that Asani's absence caused a strategy change in the match against Tractor. The coach emphasized that his team is professional and compensates for missing players.

Khoddadad Azizi, the caretaker of Tractor team, criticized the difficult journey of the team to Oman for the Asian Elite League. He pointed to the issuance of a direct flight permit for Esteghlal to Qatar and called for officials to address the issue. Tractor is traveling to Oman via Najaf and Baghdad for the league match.

The President of Lebanon welcomed Trump's decision to lift the 41-year restriction on direct flights between the US and Lebanon. This restriction was imposed in 1985 after a plane hijacking. Lifting the restrictions does not mean immediate resumption of flights and requires procedural steps and necessary permits.

The dispatch of Iranian pilgrims to Umrah has been delayed due to unresolved flight status and lack of pilgrimage currency. The Hajj and Pilgrimage Organization has prepared the arrangements but the start of flights depends on technical approvals and flight schedules. The government has not yet allocated the required currency for the trips.

The execution sentence of a suspect accused of killing a police officer in Damghan was carried out. The execution took place early morning on Saturday, October 10. More details are published by Harana News Agency.

Mostafa Mehrayin, a sociologist, was arrested and transferred to prison to serve an eight-year sentence. He was sentenced to eight years of imprisonment, five of which are enforceable. Mehrayin was arrested on June 15, 2025, after publishing a critical letter addressed to Ali Khamenei.

Student protests in France have sparked widespread reactions in Europe. The UN Human Rights Office has expressed concern about the treatment of protesters. This issue has attracted the attention of international organizations.

The fiancé of Aida Aghili spoke beside her tomb, calling traitors those who trample on the blood of the Iranian people to stay in power. Aida Aghili, 34, was killed by Islamic Republic agents in Tehran on January 8, 2026. This video was published on social media.

Mohsen Araki criticized Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah for attending the Saudi embassy celebration in Tehran. He stated that one cannot speak of supporting the oppressed while remaining silent about the oppression of the Yemeni people. Araki called for serious attention from officials to this issue.

Ali Sadrozadeh commented on the intense clashes around Bab al-Mandab. He said if the forces supporting the Yemeni government secure control of the strait, Taiz, and parts of the Red Sea coast, the balance of power will shift against the Houthis. He emphasized that the battle is ongoing and neither side has achieved a decisive victory.

King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was attacked again and evacuated. Flights at the airport have been suspended. This attack occurred two days after a previous attack by the Houthis on the same airport.

During the orchestral performance of "Arash" at Spinas Hall in Tehran, the audience booed Esmail Baghayi, the spokesperson of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This incident occurred on the evening of Friday, October 9. The audience reacted negatively to Baghayi's remarks during this cultural event.

Amnesty International reported that after the unlawful killing of protesters, Iranian authorities launched a campaign to suppress their families. The report addresses the repression and cruelty against the families of those killed in the Women, Life, Freedom uprising. The full documentary is available on YouTube.

A citizen from Bandar Abbas reported that after waiting for several hours in a nighttime fuel queue, he could not get gasoline. He described the situation under the Islamic Republic's flag in this way. This report was sent to Iran International.

In a Bundesliga match, Augsburg took the lead against Bayern Munich within the first eight seconds due to a mistake by Manuel Neuer. Rubin Flahau scored the fastest goal in Bundesliga history using this error. This goal broke the previous record held by Karim Bellarabi and Kevin Volland.

During the match between Peykan and Shams Azar, Peykan's coach Saket Elhami slapped his player Hojjat Ahmadi at halftime. This incident occurred in front of players, spectators, and television cameras. Images of this event were released by the Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting.
Farshad Rezaei, a citizen from Divandareh, was arrested by security forces on Tuesday, October 6. He was transferred to a detention center in Sanandaj.

The fourth annual run and walk event for seeking justice for the victims of flight PS752 was held in Toronto. The event commemorated the 176 victims of the flight. Families of the victims invited people to participate in the event.

Agence France-Presse reported, citing a hospital source in Riyadh, that dozens were injured in a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport. At least five of the injured are in intensive care. Most of the injured and those in intensive care are Saudi nationals.

The IRGC Ground Forces announced the deployment of commandos to the western borders. The commander of the Army Ground Forces stated that 50 combat and support units have been stationed at the borders. These actions come as Trump did not rule out the possibility of war before the elections.

Tractor is leading the Premier League with 17 points and one more game played. Persepolis, with 16 points, will top the table if they win or draw their postponed match. Four postponed matches from week seven will be played this week, potentially changing the team rankings.

Human rights activists in Iran reported that 2,003 people were executed in the past year. This number represents a 29% increase compared to the previous period. At least 69 of those executed faced political and security charges.

Iranians residing in Richmond planted four trees in memory of four service and rescue personnel who died in Iran. The event aims to keep the memory of the deceased alive and raise awareness among the local community and politicians. The tree planting and memorial plaque installation will continue in other cities.

A conference organized by Amnesty International is being held in Lund, Sweden, on the International Day Against the Death Penalty. The conference discusses the increase in executions in Iran and the situation of political prisoners. Human rights activists are exploring ways to combat the death penalty.

On the afternoon of October 10, a loud explosion was heard at Riyadh International Airport, leading to partial evacuation. Reports indicate the airport was targeted by Yemeni Houthi missile attacks, injuring dozens. All incoming flights to Riyadh have been canceled or diverted, and Saudi authorities have not yet confirmed the attack.

Donald Trump stated that he has just been informed about the explosion at Riyadh airport and will make a decision about it. He also said that a decision will be made regarding joining Saudi Arabia's attacks against the Houthis and that they act quickly. Trump will also review the issue of Iran and the attacks.

The disciplinary committee of the Portuguese Football Federation has temporarily suspended Cristiano Ronaldo due to leaving the national team camp. The case is being handled urgently, but the final punishment has not yet been determined. Ronaldo left the national team camp after being benched in the match against Norway, and now a non-automatic suspension has also been applied to him.

The IRGC Navy announced that a supertanker carrying crude oil attempting to exit through an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz suffered a severe explosion due to hitting a naval mine. The tanker had turned off its navigation and positioning systems. The IRGC Navy warned that a severe fire is the fate of any tanker violating the security and regulations of the Strait of Hormuz.

The United Nations, the European Union, Canada, and Japan condemned the US sanctions against the International Criminal Court. The US State Department called the court rogue and imposed new sanctions. Payam Akhavan described these sanctions as unprecedented and harmful to the people of Iran.

Donald Trump responded to a question about whether the recent attack on Riyadh airport would change his decision on attacking Iran by saying, "We will see." He had previously stated he would not attack Iran before the midterm elections. These remarks were in reaction to the recent attack in Saudi Arabia.
A group of Iranians residing in Finland held a protest gathering in Helsinki. The gathering took place on October 10. They expressed their support for Prince Reza Pahlavi.

Vahid Yazdanian, Deputy for National Information Network Development, stated that in case of renewed war or unrest, internet shutdown is possible but the extent is unclear. He also mentioned that the government's and president's role in this area may become more prominent. Earlier, the Deputy Legal Minister said the country can manage crises without internet shutdown.

Nejat Bahrami said that the Islamic Republic and its affiliated media have tried to portray Marco Rubio's remarks about the Achaemenid attack on Greece as a sign of US opposition to Iranian civilization. He added that Rubio has distinguished between the Iranian people and civilization on one hand and the Islamic Republic on the other in past years.

The Human Rights Group Halvash reported an attack on a military vehicle in Cheshme Ziarat, Zahedan. The cultural-social deputy commander of Sistan and Baluchestan police was killed in the incident. The People's Fighters Front claimed responsibility, and the Speaker of Parliament demanded punishment for those responsible.

On Alireza Ghasemi's birthday, his sister read a memorial and said his name will not be silenced. Alireza Ghasemi, 23, was killed during the protests on January 9, 2026, in Mashhad. This video was shared on social media.
Putin delivered a message from Tehran to Trump. New signs of US readiness for an attack have been observed. This was discussed in the audio version of Titrawol with Niusha Saremi.
Israeli Channel 12 reported that senior US military officials told the Israeli army chief that they have orders to prepare for a possible large-scale attack on Iran within the next three weeks.

Three workers died in separate incidents in Piranshahr, drilling rig 93 Fath, and a sawmill workshop in Mamuniyeh. Two of the deceased were seasonal and contract workers. These incidents resulted in the death of these individuals.

The US Department of Defense increased the official number of American military deaths in operations against the Islamic Republic to 21. This change came after adding two non-combat deaths. One was a 46-year-old Army National Guard major who died in Kuwait on March 6, 2025, and the other was a Navy member who died by suicide in September.

Barcelona defeated Getafe in the eighth week of La Liga with goals from Gordon, Gabriel Jesus, and Jules Kounde. Barcelona continued their streak of high-scoring victories. They strengthened their position at the top of the league table by maintaining a 100% winning record.

Manchester United drew 1-1 against Tottenham in the sixth week of the English Premier League. Brian Emboumo scored for Tottenham and the opposing team was reduced to 10 players. In stoppage time, Dominic Solanke scored the equalizer for Tottenham.

The Saudi Civil Aviation Authority announced that the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has ceased operations following an attack. Donald Trump stated he is aware of the attack and will make a decision regarding it. The exact number of injured and the extent of damage have not yet been disclosed.

Ali Birami's birthday was held at his gravesite with family and close ones present. Ali Birami, 24, was killed during the protests on January 9 in Nazarabad, Alborz. The video was shared on social media.

Saket Elhami, head coach of Peykan, responded in a press conference after the game against Shams Azar that he was not aware when he slapped Hojjat Ahmadi and it was not intentional. He described Hojjat Ahmadi as a kind-hearted boy and said the action was just a way of saying 'well done.' Elhami also mentioned that he said 'well done' to a couple of other players in the same way.

Donald Trump criticized Volodymyr Zelensky, saying he could have ended the war but chose not to. Trump accused Zelensky of causing problems for the global fuel market and American farmers. He called for stopping attacks on refineries and emphasized he would not allow these attacks to harm American farmers.

Mehdi Mahdavi-Azad said in the program "Cheshmandaz" that unprecedented pressures, including the threat of war and sanctions, have increased the likelihood of a new war. He added that the Strait of Hormuz no longer holds its former value for the Islamic Republic, and Donald Trump is standing firm on increasing pressures. Mahdavi-Azad warned that if the countdown for such structures begins, its ticking sound will be heard.

Meysam Mehrani said Russia can help open negotiation channels between Iran and the US, but ending the war is not Moscow's priority. He added that Russia's military relationship with Iran does not imply a defense commitment and Russia will not enter a direct war with the US. Iran seeks a stronger mediator, and Russia's role mainly serves to increase Moscow's bargaining power.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, referred to the Achaemenid invasion of Greece in a speech in Athens, which sparked widespread reactions. Iranian media and officials responded with a nationalist approach. Tasnim News Agency stated that Rubio's remarks indicate that America's problem is with Iranian civilization, not the Islamic Republic.

Reza Talebi referred to a Bloomberg report stating that Iran's military capability is worn out but missile factories remain active and infrastructure has been rebuilt. He added that Israel needs logistical support from the US for a large-scale conflict with Iran. The election calendars of the US and Israel may influence the timing of decisions regarding a potential conflict.
Iranians in Sweden gathered in Gothenburg on Saturday. They displayed an artistic image of Empress Farah Pahlavi. This was done to honor her.

Trump stated in his Clarksville speech that he will quickly end dealings with the Islamic Republic. He claimed that the naval forces and military equipment of the Islamic Republic have been destroyed. Trump also mocked the officials of the Islamic Republic and called them crazy.

Real Madrid defeated Villarreal 1-0 in the eighth week of La Liga. The only goal was scored by Diomande in the 63rd minute, marking his first goal for Real. Vinicius received a direct red card after a foul and may miss the El Clasico.

Trump warned in a speech in Clarksville that the Islamic Republic may take further actions against the US before the midterm elections. He stated that the US will quickly end dealings with the Iranian government. Trump also mentioned that the US is increasing oil exports from the Strait of Hormuz and is considering renaming it to Trump Strait.

A Saudi-led military coalition announced that a projectile landed near King Fahd International Airport in Dammam. This airport is located in the eastern region of Saudi Arabia. After attacks on Riyadh, this airport has become an important alternative to the capital's airport.

According to Aram News, US and Israeli warplanes conducted an attack drill over Iraqi airspace targeting the Islamic Republic. An Israeli F-35 refueled mid-air with the help of US KC-46 tankers. This exercise was likely aimed at attacking military and nuclear facilities.

Donald Trump said in his speech in Tennessee that the situation with Iran has calmed down somewhat. He predicted that Iran might take additional actions before the elections. Trump also emphasized that he has treated Iran well and with patience.

The Saudi Civil Aviation Authority announced that at least 12 people were killed and 309 injured in an attack on Riyadh airport. This is the third attack this week on King Khalid Airport, and the airport's operations were temporarily suspended. Western governments have urged their citizens to stay away from the airport and surrounding areas.

Morad Veisi announced that 10 kilograms of gold went missing in the public warehouses company in Tehran, which is under the pension fund. This happened while the pension funds have not paid retirees' arrears. Veisi suggested the possibility of involvement of pension fund managers in this theft.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported an incident in the Strait of Hormuz. An unknown projectile hit an oil tanker, causing a fire. The crew is safe, and the extent of damage is currently unknown.

The audio version of the program 'Politics' with Murad Vaisi has been released. This episode covers the simulation of an attack on the Islamic Republic in Iraqi airspace. The program was broadcast on Iran International.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, believes the Islamic Republic is leading Iran towards a fifth war. He referenced previous wars involving Iran and warned that this new war would harm the country's infrastructure and people. He also stated that the Islamic Republic will not cease its warmongering.

Kambiz Tavana said that the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including targeting a civilian airport, may push Riyadh to a more serious response or forming a new coalition. Donald Trump emphasized that if Tehran acts, the US will respond quickly and strongly. It is still unclear whether the US will have a direct military presence against the Houthis.

Amirhossein Mirasmaeili said the intensification of Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia could change Donald Trump's calculations about responding to the Islamic Republic. He added that Iran uses proxy groups to increase the cost of potential attacks, but this strategy may backfire. Regional support for Riyadh indicates further isolation of the Islamic Republic.

Donald Trump stated that the US has prevented the Islamic Republic from acquiring nuclear weapons. He said Tehran will likely try harder to harm the US before the elections. Trump also spoke about Iran's military capabilities and the possible renaming of the Strait of Hormuz.

The Saudi-led military coalition attributed the attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Saturday, October 10, to Yemeni Houthis. The coalition described the attack as a war crime and promised a decisive response. No further details about the nature of the response have been announced.

Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, announced that an American citizen was killed in recent attacks on Saudi Arabia. He strongly condemned the attacks and called for their immediate cessation. No further details about the identity or location of the death were provided.

The US Central Command announced that a commercial cargo ship in the Sea of Oman attempting to bypass Iran's naval blockade was disabled. A US military jet targeted the rear section of the ship Ocean Mulika, disabling its propulsion system without harming the crew. The ship had tried to pass through the area after leaving an Iranian port.

Trump stated that Saudi Arabia has the ability to defend itself against Houthi attacks. He described the recent attacks on Saudi Arabia as terrible. Trump also said that Saudi Arabia has good fighters.

Mike Huckabee, the US ambassador to Israel, identified the Islamic Republic as responsible for recent Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. He said Tehran's financial and training support has empowered the Houthis. Washington's goal is to contain attacks by groups supported by the Islamic Republic.

Shahram Khaledi said the main priority for the US is the Islamic Republic. He added that the US might only intervene with limited and targeted attacks in the conflicts between the Saudi coalition and the Houthis. These remarks concern Washington's policy in the region.

Shahbaz Sharif, Pakistan's Prime Minister, emphasized Islamabad's commitment to Saudi Arabia's security after the Houthi attack on King Khalid Airport in Riyadh. He stated that Pakistan stands firmly alongside Saudi Arabia within the framework of the Makkah defense pact. This statement was made based on the joint defense agreement of Makkah and the brotherly ties between the two countries.

Donald Trump emphasized continuing pressure on the Islamic Republic in his speech. He warned that if Tehran increases tensions alongside the US midterm elections, Washington will respond quickly and firmly. This was discussed in an interview with Kambiz Tavana.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi said the Islamic Republic may try to gain concessions from Donald Trump before the US midterm elections by escalating tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and increasing Houthi attacks. He also commented on Russia's role in mediating between Tehran and Washington. According to him, Moscow wants to strengthen its position, but the US is unlikely to back down from its stance on long-term uranium enrichment.
